title: The homogeneous adjacency spectrum of the Fano plane
creator: Anonymous
normalization: Symmetric order-three adjacency tensor with entries 1/2 on permutations of each line; A x^2 = lambda x^[2].

claims.claim: Degree-448 resultant factorization with nineteen distinct roots.
claims.dependency: Correct modular Poisson recursion and inductively certified CRT lifts.

claims.claim: H-spectrum is exactly 0,1,3 and the real root of lambda^3+2lambda^2+2lambda-2.
claims.dependency: F1 completeness, explicit witnesses, rational positive sum-of-squares obstruction and point-transitivity.

claims.claim: At each root of lambda^2+lambda+2 the projective eigenscheme is a smooth geometrically irreducible degree-eight genus-three curve.
claims.dependency: Characteristic-zero saturation, Hilbert series, Jacobian minors, minimal resolution and connectedness argument.
